summary.rule: Scientific status: do not mark a check done without evidence.

checks.name: Enforce single-template rule
checks.evidence: phase1_architecture_core.compile_unified_template enforces compiled_template_count=1.

checks.name: Remove duplicate logic merges
checks.evidence: phase1 conflict pass deduplicates template candidates before selecting one compiled template.

checks.name: Add conflict resolution priority
checks.evidence: template priority table resolves source conflicts deterministically.

checks.name: Add timeout handling

checks.name: Add retry logic for tools

checks.name: Add performance scoring
